For Ireland, a few of their batters got off to starts but none went on to make it significant. Three batters managed to cross the 30-run mark, Harry Tector went onto score a fifty but they needed him to score a bg one. The others really struggled. Apart from the three, no other batter managed to cross the 20-run mark and Ireland will be disappointed especially after electing to bat.

Bangladesh will be pretty pleased with their effort with the ball, especially after being asked to field. It was the seamers who started the good work by picking early wickets but it Taijul Islam was the star with the ball. Whenever a partnership was building, he always provided a wicket. He received good support by the others too. Overall, it is a really good performance by the hosts.

They struck early courtesy Shoriful Islam, Ebadot Hossain then did not take long to make an impact. Andy Balbirnie and Harry Tector then tried to steady things and were looking good but Taijul Islam struck. Curtis Campher and Tector though ensured there were no more wickets to fall before the break. The two now need to apply themselves and put up a good stand. Bangladesh on the other hand, will want to continue the good work. The element of surprise in the first session was that Shakib did not come onto bowl but we might just see him soon with the ball in hand. A tricky second session awaits for the visitors. Can they come out on top then? We will find out.

It is time for the one-off Test between Ireland and Bangladesh. The series has been dominated by the hosts so far. Out of the 5 completed games so far they have managed to win 4. However, the visitors head into this game after a morale boosting win. That though was in the shortest format. This is now the longest format where they'll face a stiffer challenge.
